soul_dir.hint: Where this being's memory lives (soul.db, config.toml, identity/). Empty = data/plugin_data/astrbot_plugin_memory_core/soul. Embedding settings go into config.toml inside it.

owner_ids.hint: Sender IDs of the owner. Private chats with them get the 'owner' scope; their content is never brought up elsewhere.

owner_command_platforms.description: Platforms where the owner may use the memory commands
owner_command_platforms.hint: /mem_forget, /mem_approve and the other /mem_ commands only work for the owner, in a private chat, on these platforms (default: only AstrBot's local web chat). Everyone else, and every group, gets no answer. Add a chat platform here only if you really need it.

owner_name.description: How the being refers to its owner
owner_name.hint: All owner accounts (on any platform) are one person with this name.

owner_title.description: What the being calls its owner
owner_title.hint: Used in prompts (diary, speaker line), e.g. 爸爸 or 主人. Empty = owner_name.

self_name.description: How the being refers to itself in memories

skip_prefixes.description: Do not record messages starting with

record_group_messages.hint: Only groups that pass AstrBot's whitelist ever reach this plugin.

inject_identity.description: Use the being's identity documents as its persona
inject_identity.hint: identity/self.md (core identity), self-image.md and voice.md in the memory directory go first in the system prompt, plus a line saying whether the speaker is the owner. Edits apply on the next reply.

replace_framework_persona.hint: Only when an identity document exists. Keeps two personas from contradicting each other.

inject_memories.description: Inject recalled memories before each reply

remember_check_related.hint: When the model remembers something on purpose, related memories in the same place are checked first (one extra model call): it may update or merge them instead of adding a duplicate.

llm_provider_id.hint: Empty = the current default chat provider. A cheap, fast model is enough.

consolidate_min_new.description: Minimum new messages per chat before consolidating it

consolidate_idle_minutes.description: Also consolidate a quiet chat after N minutes
consolidate_idle_minutes.hint: A chat with fewer new messages than consolidate_min_new is consolidated once it has been quiet this long, so a short talk is not left waiting. 0: off.

diary_enabled.hint: After diary_hour, the being writes the previous day's diary (owner-only memory, also saved as diary/<date>.md) and rewrites identity/self-image.md. /mem_diary writes today's now.

diary_hour.hint: Late-night chats before this hour belong to the previous day.

diary_quiet_days.description: Also write on days when nothing happened

diary_tool_per_day.description: Times a day the being may write its diary itself
diary_tool_per_day.hint: diary_write, only in the owner's private chat. What happens after is added early next morning. 0 = only the daily diary.

self_image_days.description: Diaries considered when rewriting the self-image

tidy_enabled.hint: Once a day (after the diary): archive memories that faded (not recalled for long, not important), and merge memories that say the same thing (needs an embedding model). /mem_tidy runs it now.

archive_below.description: Archive memories whose strength fell below
archive_below.hint: Strength halves every 30 days without being recalled. Important memories (>= 0.8) and diaries are never archived; archived ones come back when deliberately recalled.

inner_state.hint: Before each reply: how long since the owner was here, today's visits and outings, energy by the hour, longing for the owner, and a mood judged after each quiet conversation. Things about the owner are only shown in the owner's private chat.

abilities_enabled.description: Tell the being what it can do
abilities_enabled.hint: Lists what the installed plugins let the being do (a plugin can describe itself with being_abilities(owner); otherwise its description and tools are used). In the owner's private chat the being notices a new or a lost ability once and remembers it.

abilities_fresh_hours.description: Hours a new ability is marked new

vision_enabled.hint: Pictures in messages are described by a vision model, the being reacts to the description and remembers it. Needs vision_providers.

vision_providers.hint: AstrBot provider IDs that accept images (e.g. a local Ollama qwen3-vl). The next one is tried when one fails; the same picture is only looked at once. Leave AstrBot's own image caption provider empty, or pictures are described twice.

vision_keep_pictures.hint: owner: only pictures from the owner's private chat are kept in attachments/images (at most 2 MB each). The description is always remembered.

vision_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for one picture
vision_timeout.hint: A local model loading for the first time can take a minute.

mood_idle_minutes.description: Judge the mood after N quiet minutes
mood_idle_minutes.hint: One model call per conversation or outing.

longing_half_hours.description: Longing reaches half after N hours apart

sleep_hour.hint: Drifts a little each day (timing_jitter of an hour). Asleep: very low energy; other plugins (thinking-of-you) do not reach out.
